A little something for

Pavi,
this is for you.

I didn't want to send you just another apology message.
I wanted you to have something you could open, read slowly, and feel.

Music begins with your first tap ♫
01 · I'm sorry, Pavi

I hurt you. And I'm truly sorry.

I know saying sorry cannot instantly erase what you felt. I take responsibility for my actions, and I never want to make you feel that way because of me again.

02 · What I realised

You deserved comfort, not another weight.

When life is already difficult, I should be the person who makes things a little easier. I want you to feel safe being yourself with me — even when you're tired, angry, quiet or not okay.

03 · What I promise you

I'll show you, not just tell you.

I will think before I react. I will listen. I will respect your feelings. And I will learn from this instead of repeating the same mistake.

04 · When life gets hard

You don't have to carry everything alone.

I can't fix every difficult situation, but I can stand beside you through it. You don't have to pretend to be strong around me.

05 · One thing I want you to know

I don't want one mistake to define us.

I know trust is built through actions, not one apology. So I won't ask you to believe me just because I said these words. I'll show you.
